entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 99:1-9 . God's government is especially exercised in and for His Church, which should praise Him for His gracious dealings.

entries.heading: 2. great in Zion
entries.text: 2. great in Zion --where He dwells ( Ps 9:11 ).

entries.heading: 3. thy . . . name
entries.text: 3. thy . . . name --perfections of justice, power, &c. great and terrible name --producing dread ( De 10:17 ), and to be praised by those over whom He is exalted ( Ps 97:9 ). it is holy --or, "He is holy" ( Ps 99:5, 9; Isa 6:3 ).
4, 5. To His wise and righteous government all nations should render honor. king's . . . judgment --His power is combined with justice. he is holy --(compare Ps 22:3 ).

6-8. The experience of these servants of God is cited for encouragement. among . . . priests, among . . . upon the Lord [and] He spake . . . pillar --may be referred to all three (compare Ex 18:19; Le 8:15; De 5:5; 1Sa 9:13 ).

entries.heading: 7. cloudy pillar
entries.text: 7. cloudy pillar --the medium of divine intercourse ( Ex 33:9; Nu 12:5 ). Obedience was united with worship. God answered them as intercessors for the people, who, though forgiven, were yet chastened ( Ex 32:10, 34 ).
